name: WTC : The Manchester Report
source:
Chuck Sterling is Manchester, New Hampshire's most popular late-night chat show host, as well as being a TV presenter, newsreader, compere and possible Council operative.

Tonight, on his chat show, "Manchester Report", coming live from the "Wendel Minx Broadcasting Center", Chuck will be interviewing local entrepreneur Abigail Harrera and well known radio personality Grendel Jinx. 

[From [url=https://triority.itch.io/wtc-the-manchester-report]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
查克·斯特林 (Chuck Sterling) 是新罕布什尔州曼彻斯特最受欢迎的深夜脱口秀主持人，也是一名电视主持人、新闻播音员、主持人和可能的市议会工作人员。

今晚，查克将在“温德尔·明克斯广播中心”直播的脱口秀“曼彻斯特报道”中采访当地企业家阿比盖尔·哈雷拉和著名电台名人格伦德尔·金克斯。

[来自[url=https://triority.itch.io/wtc-the-manchester-report]itch.io[/url]]
